arguments.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite atlas on a truly transparent alpha background, landscape canvas exactly 3 equally sized square columns by 2 equally sized square rows. Six isolated sprites, centered in their own cells with generous transparent margin, no cell outlines, no text, no labels, no floor rectangle and no painted checkerboard. Cohesive high-detail hand-painted dark industrial science-fiction artwork for a top-down 2D space shooter, viewed straight down orthographically, crisp silhouette and carefully painted metallic texture, grounded physical facility machinery bolted to a small rectangular base, subtle integral contact shading only. These are buildings/ground installations, never robots, creatures, hovering orbs, circular boss cores or spaceships. TOP LEFT: an angular shield-generator installation with two tall rectangular steel pylons, copper conduits and a luminous teal energy bar between the pylons, warm gold accents clearly marking an objective. TOP MIDDLE: a rectangular power capacitor bank with three thick amber-lit cylindrical batteries held within a heavy angular steel rack, cables and vents. TOP RIGHT: a compact rectangular armored weapons-base ground turret, one heavy forward-pointing cannon barrel facing the top edge, mechanical hinges and a boxy steel mounting plinth, small red status lamps. BOTTOM LEFT: the exact same shield-generator installation after destruction, broken pylons, bent copper conduit, blackened empty energy bar, no flames or smoke obscuring shape. BOTTOM MIDDLE: the exact same capacitor bank after destruction, cracked battery casings and burnt dark vents, no fireball. BOTTOM RIGHT: the exact same turret after destruction, visibly bent barrel and split angular armor, no fireball. Keep each damaged version aligned to its intact counterpart above at identical sprite scale and footprint. Physical rectangular silhouettes, vivid controlled material detail readable after reduction to about 96 screen pixels. Preserve proper transparent alpha through holes between parts. No broad external glow, no environment, no user interface, no typography.
